headline: Bids for New City Hall parking lot stormwater design, plus contract amendments and new RFP approvals for clean-up, fleet parts, and heavy equipment services.
summary: Public input comes first, with bids for the City Hall parking lot stormwater design. The rest of the agenda lists Public Works and Purchasing contract amendments, plus new RFP approvals from Purchasing and Zoning.
